name: savvy-progress
description: Lab blobs fork of savvy-progress: progress bar, agents panel with per-run blob colours, and a lab table of each agent's file work.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The theme for every layer: lab (built in) or the name of a folder in the themes folder. /agents-theme switches it while Claude Code runs.

agentsTheme.title: Agents layer theme
agentsTheme.description: Optional: a different theme for the agent sprites only.

itemsTheme.title: Items layer theme
itemsTheme.description: Optional: a different theme for the work items on the table only.

benchTheme.title: Bench layer theme
benchTheme.description: Optional: a different theme for the table and the planned build loop only.

themesDir.title: Themes folder
themesDir.description: Where themes are found: every folder in it with a pack.json is a theme, named after the folder.

spritePack.title: Sprite pack folder (earlier releases)
spritePack.description: Earlier setting: one theme folder by path. Prefer themesDir and theme.

showMain.title: Main session row
showMain.description: on: the panel always has a row for the main session (its state, files, context and cost), for daily work without subagents. off: subagents only.

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: on: the panel opens when a session starts (Claude Code places it from 144 columns). off: it opens with the first subagent or /agents-info.
